newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher in thin trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as most blue chips gained in lower volume after the trading resumed following a three-day Eid al-Adha festival, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index rose 7.25 points or 0.65 percent at 1,121.15 on a turnover of 14 million taka. Gainers led lossers by 40 to 34.
"There were very few investors in the market. In fact, a holiday mood is still prevailing in the market. But the rally continued as the scrips were attractive," said one broker.
Bangladesh Oxygen gained 3.46 to 181.64, Beximco Pharma lost 0.5 to 123.62 and Bengal Fine Ceramic was up 10.67 to 440.67.
